name: Personal Bank: a scaled item keeps its stored instance level across a deposit/withdraw round trip
contract: #7468: the bank slot packet built by SendTabList (AscensionPersonalBank.cpp) only ever sent entry/count/enchant/random-property, never the per-instance scaling level NativeItemScaling keeps keyed by item GUID, so a scaled item showed its base (level 1) form while sitting in a bank tab, and withdrawing it did not resend the level either (ItemArrived/SendAllLevels are not called by MoveItemToInventory). SendTabList and WithdrawToPlayer now call a small SendItemLevel helper that resends the stored ItemLadder level addon packet whenever an item is listed in a bank tab or handed back to the player. This regression checks the server-side instance level data itself (NativeItemScaling::InstanceLevel, read through the carried_item_scaling_level metric, not the client's rendering of the bank or inventory window): the stored level, and the item level/required level it drives, must be exactly the same before the deposit and after the withdraw. Lionfur Armor (17922) is bind-on-equip, so an unequipped looted copy is not soulbound and deposits normally into either bank. It also asserts the raw UpdateObjectAddon packet (0x0578/1400, ItemLadder::BuildLevelAddon: guid, field 0, level) sent after the deposit and after the withdraw, confirming the addon itself carries the stored level rather than only the server-side NativeItemScaling state.

steps.label: Let the vault summon land in the world
SETUP: the looted armor is not soulbound yet (bind on equip)
SETUP: the looted armor stores a non-zero scaling instance level
The bank listing resent an UpdateObjectAddon level packet (0x0578)
That packet's level field carries the stored instance level
The withdrawn armor is back in the bags
The withdraw resent a second UpdateObjectAddon level packet
That second packet's level field still carries the stored instance level
The round trip keeps the stored scaling instance level
The round trip keeps the scaled required level
